description: Route handlers in protected route groups without their own auth check — relying solely on Next.js middleware

patterns.label: Route handler without backend auth check — relies on Next.js middleware

examples: export async function GET(request) { return Response.json({ ok: true }) }
export async function POST(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); return Response.json(body) }
export const PATCH = async (req: Request) => Response.json({})
export function DELETE(request) { return new Response(null, { status: 204 }) }
notes: deepsec globs '**/app/**(protected)**/route.*' are minimatch extended globs that match any single folder; the port matches the route groups (protected), (dashboard) and (auth). deepsec words the label by route group and flags the first handler; the port uses one label and flags every handler line. Gate: deepsec tech [nextjs]; kalkan uses the tech tag next (or nextjs).
